title: Texas death row convictions partly based on hypnotic regression

tellings.quote: two guys on death row right now in Texas

plain: Two men are on death row in Texas today after being convicted partly on evidence drawn out through hypnotic regression, which means using hypnosis to bring back supposedly buried memories. Michels passes this on from the scientist John Blitch, who says he was taken by aliens himself. Michels raises it to show how much weight the law has given to memories brought back under hypnosis.
